fields.Name: ORD-39 - IS-A Entities
fields.Description: MemberJunction's IS-A (Table-Per-Type) machinery against a real database, through Orders' two disjoint pairs: an Event Product IS-A Product and an Event Order Line IS-A Order Line. One key, two tables, one record: saving the child writes the parent first and each column to the table that owns it; the child's view carries the parent's columns; loading the parent finds its subtype; a save on the parent is handed to the child; an existing Product can be promoted to an Event Product in place; a failed save at either level leaves no row behind; deleting either level removes both rows, and a delete on the parent returns (MJ#4850); and an order line's Event Order Line saved with its order is found again by loading the line.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: An Event Product saved through the child writes exactly one Product row and one EventProduct row under the same key, with its Product linked back to it before the save; a RunView of Event Products filters on SKU and CompanyID and sorts on Name, all Product columns; a loaded Product's ISAChild and LeafEntity are its Event Product with its own columns loaded; a rename made through a loaded Event Product updates the one Product row; Save() on a loaded Product persists edits on both levels; AttachToParent with a key that has no Product returns false and leaves a fresh chain that still saves under its own key, while an existing Product is promoted by updating it and inserting only the EventProduct row; a Product that fails validation is reported on the child as a failure to save its parent, with nothing written, and an attendee who is not a Person is refused by FK_EventOrderLine_Person with the Order Line row written before it rolled back; deleting a loaded Event Product, or a loaded Product with its Event Product linked, removes both rows within the deadline; and an Event Order Line created with EnsureISAChild and saved with its order is found again, person and note intact, by loading the order line.
